ideas.name: Option Expiration Week Effect
ideas.claim: Quantpedia describes a long S&P 500 timing strategy around the monthly option-expiration week.
ideas.quote: The research suggests that stocks with large market capitalization, that have actively traded options, tend to have substantially higher average weekly returns during these weeks.

rules.market: S&P 500, using SPY in the source
rules.timeframe: Daily closes; approximately one week holding time
rules.entry: Buy at the close on the Friday before the second Saturday of each month.
rules.exit: Sell at the close on the following Thursday.

ideas.claimed_result: For 1993–2019, the source reports 4.93% annual performance and 20.39% maximum drawdown for the SPY strategy.
required_data: S&P 500 index or index CFD price history
